test.query: SELECT toNullable(concat('key-padding-to-thirty-bytes--', toString(g))) AS a, toNullable(toInt64(g)) AS b, toNullable(toDate('2020-01-01') + g % 30) AS c, count() AS cnt FROM (SELECT if(number % 64 = 0, number % 10007, 10007 + ((number * 2654435761) % 4000000)) AS g FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) GROUP BY a, b, c HAVING cnt > 6 SETTINGS query_plan_enable_optimizations = 1, group_by_two_level_threshold = 100000, group_by_two_level_threshold_bytes = 50000000, automatic_parallel_replicas_mode = 0 FORMAT Null

SELECT toNullable(concat('key-padding-to-thirty-bytes--', toString(g))) AS a, toNullable(toInt64(g)) AS b, toNullable(toDate('2020-01-01') + g % 30) AS c, count() AS cnt FROM (SELECT intDiv(number, 2) AS g FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) GROUP BY a, b, c HAVING cnt > 1 SETTINGS query_plan_enable_optimizations = 1, group_by_two_level_threshold = 100000, group_by_two_level_threshold_bytes = 50000000, automatic_parallel_replicas_mode = 0 FORMAT Null
